news.title: Cosmo3DFlow Submitted to KDD 2026
news.description: Our paper on Wavelet Flow Matching for Spatial-to-Spectral Compression in Reconstructing the Early Universe has been submitted to KDD 2026 in Jeju, Korea.

news.title: Financial Aid Paper Accepted to IEEE BigData 2024
news.description: Our work on Large Language Models for Financial Aid in Financial Time-series Forecasting was accepted to the IEEE International Workshop on Large Language Models for Finance.

news.title: Temporal Dependencies Research at AAAI-24
news.description: Research on Temporal Dependencies and Spatio-Temporal Patterns of Time Series Models presented at AAAI-24 Doctoral Consortium in Vancouver, Canada.
